notes.title: Skeleton Dungeon Patch Note - Version 1.1
notes.notes:
•Fix the yellow skeletons projectile staying between level transitions.

•Make the yellow skeletons projectile spawn away from the player.

•Buff enemies score value.

•Fix the eye portal from spawning on the next stage after you collect 3 eyes.

•Slightly increase sword hitbox.

•Added skeleton break table.
